question: Which of the following does NOT include high powered money?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Post office savings**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **High powered money** refers to the total liability of the monetary authority, which includes the currency held by the public, cash reserves of banks, and other deposits with the RBI.
 
• Post office savings are not included in high powered money as they are not liabilities of the central bank or part of the monetary base.
 
• High powered money plays a crucial role in determining the money supply in the economy through the money multiplier effect.
 
• Components of high powered money include: **currency in circulation, bankers' deposits with the RBI, and other deposits of the RBI.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **High Powered Money (Reserve Money):**

 
 
• It is also known as "monetary base" or "reserve money."
 
• It is created by the central bank (RBI in India) and is the foundation for the money supply in the economy.
 
 
 
• **Components of High Powered Money:**
 
 
• Currency in circulation: Notes and coins held by the public.
 
• Bankers' deposits with the RBI: Reserves held by commercial banks with the central bank.
 
• Other deposits of the RBI: Deposits held by government and financial institutions with the RBI.
 
 
 
• **Post Office Savings:**
 
 
• These include savings accounts and fixed deposits maintained with post offices under various government schemes.
 
• They are not considered part of high powered money as they are not liabilities of the central bank.
 
 
 
• **Money Multiplier Effect:**
 
 
• The process by which the banking system creates money supply based on the reserve base provided by high powered money.
 
• A higher money multiplier indicates greater efficiency in the banking system to create money.
